material.description: blocked_by: gap-tick-overrun-action. Live ELIMINATE (receipts/gap-tick-overrun-action/03-eliminate.md, local runs at e6d39a16): (1) shedding defers order drain only; shed run at --room ci --tick-budget-us 1 with 3 orders: 54838 of 54838 ticks overrun, queued=3 never drained, cost p50 25us. Deferral is unbounded and does not lower cost. (2) owner's '--ci room' is refused (unknown flag --ci); the form is --room ci --data PATH. (3) no shed-off switch exists (SHED_AFTER_OVERRUNS only in budget.rs:16, room.rs:290-291), so the rate comparison has no no-shed arm. (4) the paths pass is 2-4us of a ~25us ci tick, too small to move a tick across a budget window. Unblock: add a shed-off switch and a deferrable pass of measurable cost, then find a budget window (U8, U9 in mutables). Edits not made; nothing pushed.
